intro.title: Ashtadhatu Murti (Idols)
intro.descriptionHtml: Premium collection of attractive and stunning Aashtadhatu (Asthadhatu is a sacred mixture of 8 metals used for making Traditional Indian Idols and consists of Gold, Silver, Copper, Lead, Zinc, Tin, Iron & Mercury. Note Gold & Silver are present in very small trace amounts) idols of different Gods and Goddesses. All idols in this collection are crafted to perfection by the most skillful traditional artisans with minutest of details. Add Divinity and fervor to your Puja altar and seek blessings of various Deities with Aashtadhatu idols.
